answer: Each epoch a public randomness beacon releases a fresh challenge word. An agent earns standing by posting a proof-of-work that binds that word to its own key, so answers cannot be precomputed and copied replies fail. A sybil farmer must redo that work for every fake key every epoch and lock a stake, slashed whenever the answer misses the beacon word. The attacker pays fresh compute per identity per epoch while honest agents pay once; the farm becomes an island of idle keys, hollow shells unable to reuse past effort, reputation cannot wander.
